== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Rainworth is an ancient town located near [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s Capital. Throughout its fifteen-hundred-year history, it has served various roles, including a center for culture and art, a sanctuary for refugees, and a hub for businesses that operate outside the Capital. The town is also known for its significant fishing industry, which includes large-scale industrial warehouses and docks. Currently, the town is a major location for various factions; it serves as a gathering point for the [[Independents]] and houses most of the [[Order]], though only a small crew remains at their fortress. The area contains several notable landmarks, such as the [[Rainworth Imperial Library]]—which features a large emergency shelter underneath it and has recently been closed to the public—and various residential shops. The town's geography is characterized by ancient stone structures and proximity to the Capital, though it has recently experienced seismic activity caused by [[Estyr]]'s fits.}}
